description:
As an observability engineer, you are tuning dashboards for your team's Prometheus monitoring setup. You need to enable a sample dashboard by copying a JSON dashboard definition file into the correct place for the local Grafana instance to automatically detect it. To do this, copy the file located at /home/user/prometheus_dashboard.json into the Grafana provisioning dashboard directory at /home/user/grafana/provisioning/dashboards/. Once the file has been copied, create a log file named /home/user/copy_dashboard.log. The log file should contain exactly one line with the following format: 
SUCCESS: /home/user/prometheus_dashboard.json -> /home/user/grafana/provisioning/dashboards/prometheus_dashboard.json
The automated test will check that the file /home/user/grafana/provisioning/dashboards/prometheus_dashboard.json exists and is a copy of the original JSON file and that the log file contains exactly the specified line (with no extra whitespace or lines).
